text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To get Haru Urara more experienced,
I've been
entering her into a variety of
races. On one of her
days off...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ura la la! ♪ Heehee... That was such a
fun walk!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Plus, I got to eat loads of snacks! Now
I'm extra
ready for training tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Old Lady
text_block_list.text: Well, aren't you energetic, young lady!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Being energetic is my specialty!

text_block_list.name: Old Lady
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh, I see! Wait, are you an
Umamusume by
any chance?

text_block_list.name: Old Lady
text_block_list.text:
That means you run in those races, don't
you?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I race a whole bunch! My name's
Haru
Urara!

text_block_list.name: Old Lady
text_block_list.text:
Haru Urara... Why, you're exactly like
they say!

text_block_list.name: Old Lady
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course! I often go to the
shopping district,
you see.

text_block_list.name: Old Lady
text_block_list.text:
Everyone over there is over the moon
about you.
They even created a Haru
Urara Fan Club.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Over the moon? What?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I explain to her that it's an expression
used to
describe the strong emotions a
person feels for
another, and in this
case, it shows how dedicated
her fans
are.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I see! Mm, actually, I still don't get
it!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
Old Lady
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, close enough. I'm starting to
think about
joining, too.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! Do it! Do it! Actually, can I join
too?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, exactly! ...Wait, would that be
weird?

text_block_list.name: Old Lady
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh heh, you're a funny one, that's
for sure! I
can see why everyone adores
you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After we say our goodbyes...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Heehee, I'm so happy. So many people
like me!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Now that I've got my own fan club, I
gotta work
even harder!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The more her fanbase grows, the more
motivated
Haru Urara gets.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Urara fans, let's gooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure she'll continue to gain
experience in
different races while also
growing her fanbase!
